author: Ribose Inc.
description: Renders LutaML (LML) documents as Graphviz diagrams. Owns the ruby-graphviz dependency so the lutaml core gemspecs never carry an optional render toolchain.

author: Ribose Inc.
description: Chemomer drives the native chemomer engine — the Rust InChI port gated by the shared oracle corpus — through its C ABI via FFI. from_molfile returns the InChI identifier and the InChIKey; aux_from_molfile returns the AuxInfo line. No engine code is vendored: the cdylib is a runtime artifact.

author: Ribose Inc.
description: Parses and serializes the vObject wire format used by vCard and iCalendar: BEGIN/END component nesting, property parameters, structured values, text escaping and 75-octet line folding, with the vObject value types. Registers the :vobject format into Lutaml::Model::FormatRegistry when required.

author: Tyler Schneider
description: A companion engine for keystone_ui that draws a layout's page frame for desktop browsers, phone browsers and the Hotwire Native app from one call.
